rule: One visible decision becomes one backend record path without adding UI weight.
phase_one_guardrail: No rental payment, escrow, payout, deposit, booking fee, supplier settlement, or rental commission is collected by Heavyster in phase one.

backend_objects.name: SupplierAccount
backend_objects.purpose: Store rental company profile, regions, team contacts, proof status, and listing plan.

backend_objects.name: EquipmentListing
backend_objects.purpose: Store machine category, make, model, location, availability, rate notes, and listing status.

backend_objects.name: ProofUpload
backend_objects.purpose: Store photos, licenses, insurance, inspection documents, operator certificates, and expiry dates.

backend_objects.name: DirectEnquiry
backend_objects.purpose: Store buyer request, selected machine, jobsite note, channel, copied packet, and response status.

backend_objects.name: ListingSubscription
backend_objects.purpose: Store USD 9 monthly or USD 99 yearly paid listing state without touching rental payment.

backend_objects.name: AdminReview
backend_objects.purpose: Store approval state, proof gaps, suspicious listing flags, and support notes.

backend_objects.name: MarketWedge
backend_objects.purpose: Store region, category, demand signals, supply gap, proof strength, and listing ARR opportunity.

backend_objects.name: PaymentGuardrail
backend_objects.purpose: Store the phase-one rule that buyer pays supplier directly and Heavyster takes 0% rental.

acceptance: Marketplace includes Calm Backend Handoff below Calm Decision Concierge.
Handoff changes copy and records for buyer, supplier, and founder modes.
Primary handoff action opens the correct role workspace or Build Phase.
Copy text states listing SaaS first, direct rental payment, and 0% rental take.
Build Phase includes the v148 Calm Backend Handoff contract.
Static check verifies the public handoff, contract, and JSON model.
The handoff explains backend state without adding another heavy workflow surface.
